description: This Java source file defines a helper class 'Log' in the package 'com.example.android.common.logger'. It provides static methods for logging at various levels (VERBOSE, DEBUG, INFO, WARN, ERROR, ASSERT), including chainable LogNode management. It also includes constant definitions for log levels and utility methods for logging messages and exceptions. The class serves as a custom logging utility, probably intended to intercept and redirect Android log messages.
